flags.reason: The guide and its evidence were re-checked on 28 October on the installed build, dbe0e02, only for #346 (the amount is announced once with its currency); the rest still describes the 25 October build, c8526ae. dbe0e02 changed StatusHero for #398: the mark's Neutral High at Icon Capsule Size L is a default the hero's modes override (dark grey with a white tick; AppearanceBrand Primary on the hero makes it gold; Semantic Intent System still colours it green, orange or red), the hero fills its parent instead of hugging its text, renderMedia gets the hero's modes as defaults and each element's own modes win, a hero with no title and no subtitle has no empty content wrap, and a new accessibilityLabel names the hero as a group. This entry follows the installed package and leaves out the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts (listed in its notes): Configuration “The mark is gold by default: the hero fixes its Icon Capsule to AppearanceBrand Primary, so no brand mode changes it.” and the Brand card's “The default gold mark.”; Sizing's “As wide as its words”, “The hero has no width of its own: it centres its content and wraps text only when its host is narrower.” and the 302 of “With the default copy it is 302 × 269” (269 still holds); the Don't caption “The gold tick says it worked.” (the pair is kept with the Do caption); Sources “Its mark is gold where Figma’s is dark grey with a white tick: the hero fixes the capsule’s brand mode, so only Semantic Intent System recolours it.” and “Storybook’s Without subtitle story still shows the default subtitle”; the playground's Gold readout; and the evidence's Contract, Web render, Discrepancies and Limits lines on the forced gold mark and modes, renderMedia replacing modes, the hugging width, the empty gap and no accessibility props. The guide fix belongs to #398 (Component Fix, In progress; only the 269 px against Figma's 259 is left, waiting for Marcin's call), whose publish re-checks the guide on dbe0e02. Re-extract once #398 is closed and the guide is published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch12, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: The screen after a setup, the guide's In context: Start saving swaps the setup screen for this one; the hero confirms it and Done below leaves, because the hero has no button of its own. The copy is the guide's Daily savings started hero; the mark keeps its default.
examples.jsx:
<VStack justifyVertical="space-between">
  <StatusHero
    title="Daily savings started"
    subtitle="₹50 will move from HDFC Bank ··4821 to your gold locker every morning."
    value="50"
  />
  <Button label="Done" onPress={() => {}} />
</VStack>

from.quote: Start saving swaps the setup screen for the result: the hero confirms it, and Done below leaves.

examples.purpose: A failed payment: Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative and a matching ic_close, so the mark is a red cross.
examples.jsx:
<StatusHero
  title="Payment failed"
  subtitle="No money left your account."
  value="1,200"
  iconName="ic_close"
  modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
/>

from.quote: Set Semantic Intent to System and AppearanceSystem colours it green, orange, or red; pick a matching iconName.

examples.purpose: A picture instead of the mark and the amount: renderMedia holds an 81 px Image (a placeholder URL stands for the screen's own picture).
examples.jsx:
<StatusHero
  title="Gold bought"
  subtitle="It’s in your gold locker now."
  renderMedia={<Image imageSource="https://example.com/gold-coin.png" width={81} height={81} />}
/>

from.quote: renderMedia replaces the mark and the amount with your own content, such as a picture.

props.name: renderMedia
props.description: Custom media slot content. Defaults to an IconCapsule above a MoneyValue. Hero modes are defaults; each element's own modes win. Fragments and arrays receive modes on every element child.

props.name: title
props.description: Hidden by showTitle={false} or an empty string. Declared: Title text displayed below the media slot. Default "You're set to make payments", from the component source.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Whether to render the title. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.default:
₹50 will be auto-invested daily,
stay consistent & stay golden.
props.description: A line break (\n) stays a line break; '' hides the subtitle, undefined shows the default sentence. Declared: Body/subtitle text displayed below the title. Default "₹50 will be auto-invested daily,\nstay consistent & stay golden.", from the component source.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Icon name used in the default media slot. Default "ic_confirm", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: The amount is announced once with its currency (on the web a role img named with both, such as “₹1,200”). Declared: Monetary value shown in the default MoneyValue inside the media slot. Default "50", from the component source.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol or ISO code for the default MoneyValue. Default "INR", from the component source.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Optional accessible name for the hero region.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection StatusHero reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: With Semantic Intent System it colours the mark: positive #26ab21, warning #f06e0f, negative #f50030, with a white icon.
